text.tspan: render.c packs game_state_t into the FPGA register file.
Every write goes through write_reg(word_index, value)
render_frame issues at most 51 ioctls per frame; 21 are
actually used (2 plant bitmaps + 8 zombies + 8 peas + cursor +
sun + selected). The decoder ignores word reads of 2..31.
the range 2..31 is not used by render.
